description: This PHP class 'ReportToDecorator' is part of the OrangeHRM project. It provides a decorator for the 'ReportTo' entity, allowing for setting supervisor and subordinate employees by their employee numbers and assigning reporting methods via their IDs. It leverages traits for ORM helper methods and interacts with related entities such as Employee and ReportingMethod.

classes.name: ReportToDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for the ReportTo entity, allowing to set supervisor, subordinate, and reporting method references based on IDs.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the decorator with a ReportTo entity.

methods.name: getEmployeeReportTo
methods.description: Returns the underlying ReportTo entity instance.

methods.name: setSupervisorEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the supervisor employee in the ReportTo entity based on employee number.

methods.name: setSubordinateEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the subordinate employee in the ReportTo entity based on employee number.

methods.name: setReportingMethodByReportingMethodId
methods.description: Sets the reporting method in the ReportTo entity based on reporting method ID.
